/* -----------------Timer for resent------------------------- */
var isTimerRunning = false;
var restartOTPTimer;

function otpTimer(){
	removeOTPTimer=false;
	let timerOn = true;
	isTimerRunning = true;

	function timer(remaining) {
	  var m = Math.floor(remaining / 60);
	  var s = remaining % 60;

	  if(removeOTPTimer){
		  remaining='0';
	  }

	  m = m < 10 ? '0' + m : m;
	  s = s < 10 ? '0' + s : s;
	  document.getElementById('timer').innerHTML = m + ':' + s;
	  remaining -= 1;

	  if(remaining >= 0 && timerOn) {
		  restartOTPTimer =setTimeout(function() {
	        timer(remaining);
	    }, 1000);
	    return;
	  }else{
		  document.getElementById('timer').innerHTML = '';
	  }

	  isTimerRunning = false;
	  if(!timerOn) {
	    return;
	  }
	  if(!removeOTPTimer){
	    $("#ResendotpIdBtn").css('pointer-events', 'auto');
	    $("#ResendotpIdBtn").css('opacity', '1');
	  }
	}

	timer(120);
}

function loadMapplsApi() {
    console.log('[Mappls] loadMapplsApi called');

    if (!document.getElementById('mapplsHiddenMapFinderLoc')) {
        var hiddenDiv = document.createElement('div');
        hiddenDiv.id = 'mapplsHiddenMapFinderLoc';

        document.body.appendChild(hiddenDiv);
    }

    if ($('#googleApiScriptDiv').is(':empty')) {
        var sdkScript = document.createElement('script');
        sdkScript.type = 'text/javascript';
        sdkScript.src = 'https://sdk.mappls.com/map/sdk/web?v=3.0&access_token=' + mapplsApiKey;

            pluginScript.onerror = function() { console.error('[Mappls] Plugin script failed to load'); };
            document.head.appendChild(pluginScript);
        };
        sdkScript.onerror = function() { console.error('[Mappls] SDK script failed to load'); };
        document.getElementById('googleApiScriptDiv').appendChild(sdkScript);
    } else {
        if (typeof mappls !== 'undefined') {
            initMapplsAutocomplete();
        } else {
            setTimeout(function() {
                if (typeof mappls !== 'undefined') { initMapplsAutocomplete(); }

            }, 500);
        }
    }
}

function initMapplsAutocomplete() {
//console.log('[Mappls] initMapplsAutocomplete called');
    if (typeof mappls === 'undefined') { console.error('[Mappls] mappls undefined'); return; }

    // Initialize hidden map required by mappls.search

        var inputEl = document.getElementById('searchArea');
        if (!inputEl) { console.error('[Mappls] searchArea not found'); return; }

        // Set global area for compatibility with main_location.js
        area = inputEl;

        new mappls.search(inputEl, { region: 'IND', height: 300 }, function(data) {
            console.log('[Mappls] Search callback:', data);
            if (data && data[0]) {
                var dt           = data[0];
                var eLoc         = dt.eLoc         || '';
                var placeName    = dt.placeName    || '';
                var placeAddress = dt.placeAddress || '';
                var displayName  = placeName + (placeAddress ? ', ' + placeAddress : '');
                var name         = displayName; // keep 'name' variable so rest of code works unchanged
                $(inputEl).val(displayName);
                $('#tempPincode').val(displayName);

                // Build the most specific query string we can.
                // placeName ("Patna") + placeAddress ("Bihar") = "Patna, Bihar"
                // - specific enough for Mappls geocoder to resolve to city, not just state.
                var geocodeQuery = displayName || placeAddress || placeName;

                if (geocodeQuery) {

// Fetch geocode from BACKEND (which calls Mappls API securely)
function fetchMapplsGeoCode(placeAddress, callback) {
    var ns = $('#locationPortletNamespace').val();
    $.ajax({
        url: mapplsGeocodeResourceURL,
        type: 'POST',
        dataType: 'json',
        data: {
            [ns + 'eLoc']: placeAddress
        },
        success: function(response) {
           // console.log('[Mappls] GeoCode response:', response);
            if (response && response.success && response.data && response.data.copResults) {
                var r              = response.data.copResults;
                var cityVal        = r.city || r.village || r.subDistrict || r.district || '';
                var subLocalityVal = r.subLocality || r.locality || '';
                var postalCode     = r.pincode   || '';
                var stateVal       = r.state     || '';
                var countryVal     = 'IN';
                var lat            = r.latitude  || '';
                var lng            = r.longitude || '';
                callback(cityVal, postalCode, stateVal, countryVal, lat, lng, subLocalityVal);
            } else {
                console.warn('[Mappls] No copResults in geocode response');
                callback('', '', '', 'IN', '', '', '');
            }
        },
        error: function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('[Mappls] GeoCode backend call failed:', error);
            callback('', '', '', 'IN', '', '', '');
        }
    });
}

function loadInternationalCountries() {
    $.ajax({
        url: loadInternationalCountryCityListURL,
        dataType: "json",
        type: "post",
        success: function(data) {
            if (data[0] && data[0].errorFlag) { return; }
            var countrySelect = $('#countrySelect');
            countrySelect.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
            $.each(data[0], function(i, country) {
                countrySelect.append($('<option>').val(country.countryCode).text(country.countryName));
            });
        },
        error: function() { console.error("Failed to load country list"); }
    });
}

$(document).on('change', '#countrySelect', function() {
    var selectedCountry = $(this).val();
    var ns = $('#locationPortletNamespace').val();
    var citySelect = $('#citySelect');
    citySelect.find('option:not(:first)').remove();
    citySelect.prop('disabled', true);
    if (!selectedCountry) return;
    $.ajax({
        url: loadCitiesByCountryURL,
        dataType: "json",
        type: "post",
        data: { [ns + "countryCode"]: selectedCountry },
        success: function(data) {
            if (data[0] && data[0].errorFlag) { return; }
            $.each(data[0], function(i, city) {
                citySelect.append($('<option>').val(city.cityCode).text(city.cityName));
            });
            citySelect.prop('disabled', false);
        },
        error: function() { console.error("Failed to load city list"); }
    });
});

	function attachMapplsSearch(inputEl, tempSelector, fields) {
		if (!inputEl) {
			console.warn('[Mappls] attachMapplsSearch called with null inputEl, skipping');
			return;
		}
		//console.log('[Mappls] Attaching mappls.search to: #' + inputEl.id);
		new mappls.search(inputEl, { region: 'IND', height: 300 }, function (data) {
			//console.log('[Mappls] Search callback for #' + inputEl.id, data);

			// Set selection flags FIRST so onBlur* guards don't clear the value
			if (fields.kind === 'source') {
				originSelectedFromDropDown = true;
				resetOriginValues();
			} else if (fields.kind === 'destination') {
				destinationSelectedFromDropDown = true;
				resetDestinationValues();
			} else if (fields.kind === 'intlSource') {
				resetIntlOriginValues();
			}

			if (data && data[0]) {
				 var dt = data[0];
				    var eLoc         = dt.eLoc         || '';
				    var placeName    = dt.placeName    || '';
				    var placeAddress = dt.placeAddress || '';
				    var displayName  = placeName + (placeAddress ? ', ' + placeAddress : '');

				    $(inputEl).val(displayName);
				    if (tempSelector) $(tempSelector).val(displayName);
				if (eLoc) {
					//console.log("inside if: "+eLoc);
					fetchMapplsGeoCodeRate(eLoc, fields, inputEl, tempSelector, placeName);
				} else {
					if (fields.cityField) $(fields.cityField).val(placeName);
					setMapplsValidationFlags(fields.kind, true);
				}
			}
		});
		inputEl.addEventListener('keypress', function (e) {
			if (e.keyCode === 13) { e.preventDefault(); }
		});
	}

	function setMapplsValidationFlags(kind, locResolved) {
		if (kind === 'source') {
			originSelectedFromDropDown = true;
			isLocSrc = !!locResolved;
			isCountrySrc = true;
			isStateSrc = !!locResolved;
			parseSourceResult = true;
			sourceValidationResult = true;
		} else if (kind === 'destination') {
			destinationSelectedFromDropDown = true;
			isLocDest = !!locResolved;
			isCountryDest = true;
			isStateDest = !!locResolved;
			parseDestinationResult = true;
			destinationValidationResult = true;
		}
	}

	function fetchMapplsGeoCodeRate(eLocCode, fields, inputEl, tempSelector, originalPlaceName) {
		 if (!eLocCode || eLocCode.trim() === '') {
		        console.warn('[Mappls] fetchMapplsGeoCodeRate called with empty eLoc, skipping');
		        setMapplsValidationFlags(fields.kind, false);
		        return;
		    }
        var regPin = new RegExp("^[1-9][0-9]{5}$");
        if (regPin.test(eLocCode)) {
            // eLoc IS a pincode - use directly, no geocode needed
            if (fields.pincodeField) $(fields.pincodeField).val(eLocCode);
            if (fields.cityField) $(fields.cityField).val('');
            if (fields.stateField) $(fields.stateField).val('');
            if (fields.countryField) $(fields.countryField).val('India');
            if (fields.countryCodeField) $(fields.countryCodeField).val('IN');
            setMapplsValidationFlags(fields.kind, true);
            return;
        }

        $.ajax({
            url: rtfMapplsGeocodeResourceURL,
            type: 'POST',
            dataType: 'json',
			data: { [rtfPortletNamespace + 'eLoc'] : eLocCode },
            success: function(response) {
                if (response && response.success && response.data && response.data.copResults) {
                    var r = response.data.copResults;
                    var city  = r.locality || r.city || r.village || r.subDistrict || r.district || '';
                    var pin   = r.pincode  || '';
                    var state = r.state    || '';
                    if (fields.cityField)        $(fields.cityField).val(city);
                    if (fields.pincodeField)     $(fields.pincodeField).val(pin);
                    if (fields.stateField)       $(fields.stateField).val(state);
                    if (fields.countryField)     $(fields.countryField).val('India');
                    if (fields.countryCodeField) $(fields.countryCodeField).val('IN');
                    if (!originalPlaceName && city && inputEl) {
                        $(inputEl).val(city);
                        if (tempSelector) $(tempSelector).val(city);
                    }
                    setMapplsValidationFlags(fields.kind, !!city);
                } else {
                    setMapplsValidationFlags(fields.kind, false);
                }
            },
            error: function() {
                console.error('[Mappls] Geocode backend call failed');
                setMapplsValidationFlags(fields.kind, false);
            }
        });
    }

	function validateSource() {
		if (originSelectedFromDropDown) {
			// Already resolved via Mappls selection - no need to re-geocode
			return;
		}
		$('#rate').prop('disabled', true);
		rtfGeocodePending++;
		setTimeout(function() {
			var source = document.getElementById("sourceLocation").value;
			if (!source || source.trim() === '') {
				sourceValidationResult = false;
				rtfGeocodePending--;
				$('#rate').prop('disabled', false);
				return;
			}
			$.ajax({
				url: rtfMapplsGeocodeResourceURL,
				type: 'POST',
				dataType: 'json',
				data: { [rtfPortletNamespace + 'eLoc']: source },
				success: function(response) {
					if (response && response.success && response.data && response.data.copResults) {
						var r = response.data.copResults;
						if (r.locality || r.city || r.village || r.subDistrict || r.district) { isLocSrc = true; }
						if (r.subLocality) { isSubLocSrc = true; }
						if (r.country) { isCountrySrc = true; }
						if (r.state) { isStateSrc = true; }
						sourceValidationResult = true;
					} else {
						sourceValidationResult = false;
					}
					rtfGeocodePending--;
					$('#rate').prop('disabled', false);
				},
				error: function() {
					sourceValidationResult = true;
					rtfGeocodePending--;
					$('#rate').prop('disabled', false);
				}
			});
		}, 300);
	}

	function validateForm() {
		// If geocoding is still in progress, wait and retry
		if (rtfGeocodePending > 0) {
			$('#rate').prop('disabled', true);
			var waitInterval = setInterval(function() {
				if (rtfGeocodePending <= 0) {
					clearInterval(waitInterval);
					$('#rate').prop('disabled', false);
					validateForm();
				}
			}, 100);
			return false;
		}
		modalAlert = document.getElementById('modalAlertMsg1');
		var currTimeHours = new Date().getHours();
		var currTimeMinutes = new Date().getMinutes();
		var selectedBookingTime = bookingTime.value;

		var splitOnSpace = selectedBookingTime.split(" ");
		var time = splitOnSpace[0];
		var splitTimeOnColon = time.split(":");
		var hourChck = splitTimeOnColon[0];
		var ampmValue = splitOnSpace[1];
		var newTime;

		if (ampmValue == "PM" && hourChck != "12") {
			var hourMin = time.split(":");
			var hourString = hourMin[0];
			var newHourInt = parseInt(hourString) + 12;
			var newHourString = newHourInt.toString();
			newTime = newHourString + ":" + hourMin[1];

		} else {
			newTime = time;
		}
		var newTimeHourMin = newTime.split(":");

		var inputDate = bookingDate.value;

		var d = new Date();
		var date = d.getDate() < 10 ? '0' + d.getDate() : d.getDate();

		var month = d.getMonth() + 1;

	function validateInternationalForm() {
		modalAlert = document.getElementById('modalAlertMsg1');

		var intlSrcVal = $('#intl_sourceLocation').val();
		var intlCountryCode = $('#intl_country').val();
		var intlCityCode = $('#intl_city').val();
		var intlWeight = parseFloat($('#intl_weightInKg').val()) || 0;
        var dimWeightStr = $('#calculatedWeight').html();
        var volWeightE = parseFloat(dimWeightStr) || 0;
        var volWeightD = parseFloat($('#calculatedWeightNonExpress').html()) || 0;
		var intlBookingDateVal = $('#intl_bookingDate').val();
		var intlBookingTimeVal = $('#intl_bookingTime').val();

		var weightValRegex = /^\d{0,4}(\.\d{0,2})?$/;
		var dimensionalWeight = $('#calculatedWeight').html();
		var dimWeightFloat = parseFloat(dimensionalWeight);

		if (!intlSrcVal) {
			showIntlAlert(ttfErrorLbl.enterSourceLocation);
			return false;
		}
		if (!intlCountryCode) {
			showIntlAlert('Please select a destination country.');
			return false;
		}
		if (!intlCityCode) {
			showIntlAlert('Please select a destination city.');
			return false;
		}
		if (!intlBookingDateVal) {
			showIntlAlert(ttfErrorLbl.enterBookingDate);
			return false;
		}
		if (!intlBookingTimeVal) {
			showIntlAlert(ttfErrorLbl.enterBookingTime);
			return false;
		}
		if (!intlWeight) {
			showIntlAlert(ttfErrorLbl.enterWeight);
			return false;
		}
		if (!weightValRegex.test(intlWeight)) {
			showIntlAlert(ttfErrorLbl.enterValidWeight);
			return false;
		}
		var weightFloat = parseFloat(intlWeight);
		if (parseFloat(intlWeight) > 7000) {
			showIntlAlert(ttfErrorLbl.enterWeightWithinLimit);
			return false;
		}
		if (weightFloat == 0) {
			showIntlAlert(ttfErrorLbl.enterNonZeroWeight);
			return false;
		}
		if (dimWeightFloat > 7000.00) {
			showIntlAlert(ttfErrorLbl.enterDimWeightWithinLimit);
			return false;
		}

		var effectiveWeight = Math.max(intlWeight, volWeightE, volWeightD);
        if (effectiveWeight <= 0) effectiveWeight = intlWeight;
		if (dimensionalWeight != '' && dimensionalWeight != undefined
				&& parseFloat(dimensionalWeight) > parseFloat(intlWeight)) {
			effectiveWeight = parseFloat(dimensionalWeight);
		}

		var srcCity = $('#intl_locality1').val() || '';
		var srcState = $('#intl_administrative_area_level_11').val() || '';
		var srcCountry = $('#intl_country1').val() || '';
		var srcPincode = $('#intl_postal_code1').val() || '';
		var srcStreet = $('#intl_street_number1').val() || '';

		var destCity = $('#intl_destinationCity').val() || $('#intl_city option:selected').text();
		var destCountry = $('#intl_destinationCountryName').val() || $('#intl_country option:selected').text();
		var destCountryCode = $('#intl_destinationCountryCode').val() || intlCountryCode;

		getTransitTimePrice(intlSrcVal, destCity, effectiveWeight,
				srcCity, srcState, srcCountry, srcPincode, srcStreet,
				destCity, '', destCountry, destCountryCode, '', '',
				intlBookingDateVal, intlBookingTimeVal);
		return true;
	}

	function calculateWeight() {

		$('#calculatedWeight').html('');

		var dimensions_chck = /^\d{0,3}(\.\d{0,2})?$/;

		var noOfPackages_chck = new RegExp("^[0-9]{0,3}$");

		var rowCount1 = $('#volWtTable tr').length;

		for (var inc1 = 1; inc1 <= (rowCount1 - 1); inc1++) {
			if ((($('#packages_' + inc1 + '').val()) != null && ($('#packages_'
					+ inc1 + '').val()) != "")
					|| (($('#height_' + inc1 + '').val()) != null && (($('#height_'
							+ inc1 + '').val()) != ""))
					|| (($('#length_' + inc1 + '').val()) != null && (($('#length_'
							+ inc1 + '').val()) != ""))
					|| (($('#width_' + inc1 + '').val()) != null && ($('#width_'
							+ inc1 + '').val()) != "")) {

				if (($('#height_' + inc1 + '').val()) == null
						|| ($('#height_' + inc1 + '').val()) == ""
						|| ($('#length_' + inc1 + '').val()) == null
						|| ($('#length_' + inc1 + '').val()) == ""
						|| ($('#width_' + inc1 + '').val()) == null
						|| ($('#width_' + inc1 + '').val()) == ""
						|| ($('#packages_' + inc1 + '').val()) == null
						|| ($('#packages_' + inc1 + '').val()) == "") {

					$("#volumeWeightErrorDiv").show();
					document.getElementById("volumeWeightErrorDiv").innerHTML = ttfErrorLbl.enterAllDimensions;
					modal.style.display = "block";

					return false;
				}
				if (($('#height_' + inc1 + '').val()) == 0
						|| ($('#height_' + inc1 + '').val()) == 0
						|| ($('#width_' + inc1 + '').val()) == 0
						|| ($('#length_' + inc1 + '').val()) == 0
						|| ($('#packages_' + inc1 + '').val()) == 0) {
					$("#volumeWeightErrorDiv").show();
					document.getElementById("volumeWeightErrorDiv").innerHTML = ttfErrorLbl.enterValidNonZeroDimentions;
					modal.style.display = "block";
					return false;
				}
				if ((!(dimensions_chck.test($('#height_' + inc1 + '').val())))
						|| (!(dimensions_chck.test($('#width_' + inc1 + '')
								.val())))
						|| (!(dimensions_chck.test($('#length_' + inc1 + '')
								.val())))) {

					$("#volumeWeightErrorDiv").show();
					document.getElementById("volumeWeightErrorDiv").innerHTML = ttfErrorLbl.enterValidFormatDimensions;
					modal.style.display = "block";
					return false;

				}
				if ((!(noOfPackages_chck
						.test($('#packages_' + inc1 + '').val())))) {
					$("#volumeWeightErrorDiv").show();
					document.getElementById("volumeWeightErrorDiv").innerHTML = ttfErrorLbl.enterValidNumberOfPackages;
					modal.style.display = "block";
					return false;

				}

			}

			$("#volumeWeightErrorDiv").hide();
			document.getElementById("volumeWeightErrorDiv").innerHTML = "";

		}

		var packages = "";
		var height = "";
		var length = "";
		var width = "";
		var units = "";

		$("input[name=packages_1]").each(function() {
			packages += $(this).val() + ",";
		});
		$("input[name=height_1]").each(function() {
			height += $(this).val() + ",";
		});
		$("input[name=length_1]").each(function() {
			length += $(this).val() + ",";
		});
		$("input[name=width_1]").each(function() {
			width += $(this).val() + ",";
		});
		$("select[name=units_1]").each(function() {
			units += $(this).val() + ",";
		});


		$
				.ajax({
					url : volWtCalculatorURL,
					dataType : "html",
					type : "post",
					data : {

						"_ratetransitfinderportlet_WAR_RateTransitFinderportlet_INSTANCE_ratetransitportlet_getProduct" : "E",
						"_ratetransitfinderportlet_WAR_RateTransitFinderportlet_INSTANCE_ratetransitportlet_packages" : packages,
						"_ratetransitfinderportlet_WAR_RateTransitFinderportlet_INSTANCE_ratetransitportlet_height" : height,
						"_ratetransitfinderportlet_WAR_RateTransitFinderportlet_INSTANCE_ratetransitportlet_length" : length,
						"_ratetransitfinderportlet_WAR_RateTransitFinderportlet_INSTANCE_ratetransitportlet_width" : width,
						"_ratetransitfinderportlet_WAR_RateTransitFinderportlet_INSTANCE_ratetransitportlet_units" : units,
						"_ratetransitfinderportlet_WAR_RateTransitFinderportlet_INSTANCE_ratetransitportlet_cmd" : "volWtCalculator"
						
					},
					success: function(data) {
                        var parts = data.toString().trim().split("|");
                        var volWeightE = parseFloat(parts[0]) || 0;
                        var volWeightD = parseFloat(parts[1]) || 0;

                        var isInternational = $('#rateInternationalTabContent').is(':visible');

                        $('#calculatedWeight').html(volWeightE + ' kg');
                        $('#calculatedWeight').show();
                        $('#calculatedWeightNonExpress').html(volWeightD + ' kg');
                        $('#calculatedWeightNonExpress').show();

                        $('#expressVolWeightDiv').remove();

                        // Show/hide Express modal row based on tab
                        if (isInternational) {
                            $('#expressVolWeightRow').hide();
                            $('#nonExpressRowLabel').text('Vol. Weight :');
                        } else {
                            $('#expressVolWeightRow').show();
                            $('#nonExpressRowLabel').text('Vol. Weight (Others) :');
                        }

                        // Populate labels below weight input fields
                        if (isInternational) {
                            $('#intlVolWeightNonExpress').text('Vol. Weight: ' + volWeightD + ' kg');
                            $('#intlVolWeightLabel').show();
                            $('#domVolWeightLabel').hide();
                        } else {
                            $('#domVolWeightExpress').text('Vol. Weight (Surface): ' + volWeightE + ' kg');
                            $('#domVolWeightNonExpress').text('Vol. Weight (Others): ' + volWeightD + ' kg');
                            $('#domVolWeightLabel').show();
                            $('#intlVolWeightLabel').hide();
                        }

                        if (!isInternational && parseFloat(volWeightE) > 7000.00) {
                            $("#volumeWeightErrorDiv").show();
                            document.getElementById("volumeWeightErrorDiv").innerHTML = ttfErrorLbl.enterDimWeightWithinLimit;
                        }
                        if (isInternational && parseFloat(volWeightD) > 7000.00) {
                            $("#volumeWeightErrorDiv").show();
                            document.getElementById("volumeWeightErrorDiv").innerHTML = ttfErrorLbl.enterDimWeightWithinLimit;
                        }
                    },
					error : function(xhr, status, error) {
						$('#calculatedWeight').html('');
						//        	$('#weightInKg').html('');
					}
				})

	}
